title: compiled/lake/backup-set.json: what a backup of this release copies (A1, ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.9)
description: Frozen in phase 001, emitted by k2gen.emit.lake (S15), read by scripts/backup-lake.sh in phase 002. Views, their owners and the audited tags travel in the Lakekeeper dump; a restore is followed by the catalog drift check, then make access-verify. A release id cannot appear, since the id hashes this file: the document set's tag does.

tag.description: The release tag of the document set.

entries.description: What to copy, in any order.

landing.description: A product's landing objects: the bytes as they arrived, never rebuilt.

table.description: A table: restore copies its files and registers the copy; rebuild records only that it is rebuilt from its inputs.

ref.description: Which snapshot is copied: the audited tag for a dbt output, main for bronze and platform tables.
